notes: Felt-speed bundle. First Assistant chat is faster: Ollama warms up on page open instead of at app launch, and a central prompt budget keeps every request under ~800 tokens. Overview gets a daily Today card above the hero. Every data page shows a 'Last updated · Refresh' chip, and Monitor adds a Disk sparkline next to CPU and RAM plus tiny strips on the sidebar live pills. Settings has a left nav rail that scrollspies between sections. Updates now try a small delta patch when the manifest offers one and fall back cleanly to the full download. UX cleanup: Overview no longer repeats the Quick/Full Scan buttons (they live in the title bar); History tiles are renamed Free Disk Space, Temp & Cache Size, Duplicate Files, Startup Apps; Storage and Security replay the last scan on page open instead of showing empty cards; Quick vs Full Scan is explained with durations and a one-line description of what each covers; the AI Assistant example chips are trimmed from 20 to 6. Keeps every 1.1.3 security invariant (trusted host, SHA256-verified download, 128 MiB cap, no visible terminals, below-normal CPU and I/O priority).
